entities.name: Eztli
entities.description: A heroic Oltec human and member of the Thousand Moons who flies with the aid of a giant bat and has long braids.

entities.name: Thousand Moons
entities.description: A group of which Eztli is a member.

entities.name: Oltec
entities.description: A people of Ixalan to which Eztli belongs.

entities.name: Starling, Aerial Ally
entities.description: The character of which Eztli is the digital Through the Omenpaths counterpart.

entities.name: Grim Captain
entities.description: An undead pirate captain composed of the reanimated skeletons of a dinosaur, a merfolk, a human pirate, and a vampire.

entities.name: Grim Captain's Locker
entities.description: The Grim Captain's eponymous Locker, likely a reference to Davy Jones's locker.

entities.name: Throne of the Grim Captain
entities.description: A throne associated with the Grim Captain.

entities.name: Tarrian
entities.description: A legendary hero and Venerable of the Legion of Dusk who travelled with Elenda of Garrano and recorded his travels in a journal later declared heretical.

entities.name: Legion of Dusk
entities.description: The vampire order of which Tarrian was a Venerable.

entities.name: Elenda of Garrano
entities.description: Tarrian's travel companion, with whom he entered the Temple of Aclazotz.

entities.name: Temple of Aclazotz
entities.description: A temple entered by Tarrian and Elenda around 4162 AR.

entities.name: Aclazotz
entities.description: A being about whom Tarrian wrote reverently in his journal.

entities.name: Church of Dusk
entities.description: A church whose more radical sects view Tarrian's journal as holy.

entities.name: Tarrian's journal
entities.description: Tarrian's record of his travels, declared heretical, later carried by Vito.

entities.name: Tarrian's Soulcleaver
entities.description: Tarrian's lance, carried by Vito and later taken by Huatli.

entities.name: Vito Quijano de Pasamonte
entities.description: Leader of the Queen's Bay Company who carried Tarrian's journal and lance to Ixalan's Core, where he was slain by Huatli.

entities.name: Queen's Bay Company
entities.description: A company led by Vito in 4563.

entities.name: Ixalan's Core
entities.description: The place where Vito brought Tarrian's artifacts and was killed.

entities.name: Huatli
entities.description: Took Tarrian's Soulcleaver at Ixalan's Core and slew Vito with it.

events.summary: Tarrian and Elenda of Garrano entered the Temple of Aclazotz around 4162 AR.
events.quote: He was a travel companion of Elenda of Garrano , with whom he entered the Temple of Aclazotz around 4162 AR .

events.summary: Tarrian's journal was declared heretical for its reverent writings on Aclazotz.
events.quote: He recorded his travels in a journal, later declared heretical due to its reverent writings on Aclazotz

events.summary: Vito, leading the Queen's Bay Company, brought Tarrian's artifacts to Ixalan's Core, where Huatli took the Soulcleaver and slew him with it.
events.quote: Vito brought the artifacts to Ixalan's Core , where Huatli took the Soulcleaver, slaying him with it.
